checks: Independently checked the 302-byte body at 0x7BC0..0x7CEE, stack argument and descriptor strides, pointer reloads, mode-dependent packet selection, peripheral access order, wrapped arithmetic, saturation, output correction, return value, and frame restoration against the original instructions.
Confirmed literals at 0x7CF0 and 0x7CF4 are 0xFFFFEFFF and 0x0000FFFF. The former clears control bit 31; the latter bounds the output to 16 bits.

Replayed an isolated copy of the original-instruction harness against the pinned image. All 324 fixtures passed; each supplies nonzero controlled 6AC0 status, and checks calls, result, writes, and SP.
limitations: The 6AC0 status is controlled and MMIO/RAM are synthetic. Zero-state acquisition, mode-123==7 pointer selection, helper clobbering, and physical behavior are outside this review. No canonical admission.
